summary.headline: Windows updates overview reframes Intune and Autopatch policy surfaces
summary.summary: The overview now describes Autopatch as an Intune-integrated service for keeping Windows devices protected, and explains that feature, quality, and driver update policies use the same orchestration service but can be managed directly without Autopatch enrollment.
summary.adminImpact: Choose direct Intune policies when you need update management without enrolling devices in Windows Autopatch.
